Chapter 39 Revenge

"Listen to the people inside, we are people from Luoyang City, and now the surrounding tribes have been wiped out and subdued by us, you have become a lonely army. Put down your weapons, obediently go out of the city and surrender, there is still a way to survive, if you resist stubbornly , with my Heavenly Soldier, we will turn into ashes and die without a place to be buried."

Zhong Yu beat the horse and walked in front of the tribal gate, and the loud voice reached the ears of everyone at work. Their faces changed, but they all became angry, and looked at Zhong Yu with murderous expressions. .

When the big and brave barbarians will be threatened by others, they only submit to the strong, even if the strong wants to subdue them, it is not so easy.

Otherwise, in this barbaric area, if it weren't for the barbarian who walked in from the outside decades ago, he used his powerful strength and advanced civilization to teach these barbarians a lesson and let them understand what Is the power of civilization, what is the existence of the state? What is the strongest together?

These tribes, I am afraid that there are still thousands of people are the largest tribes, thousands of people are medium tribes, hundreds of people are small tribes, less than 100 people are tribes that will be wiped out at any time, and they are not in the mainstream.

Nearly a million barbarians are scattered all over the plain. They are constantly fighting for a good hunting location, and they are constantly fighting and killing each other.

Just when this tribal form was popular in the world, but because of an outsider, he brought his incomparably advanced civilization with him. Injecting fresh blood into this plain, let all the barbarians understand what the country is, what the role of the city is, and how powerful the centralization is.

For this reason, all the tribes had to unite in order to survive, in which there was a constant struggle for power and profit, and mutual fire. Gradually, one large tribe after another was formed. From the original population of several thousand, hundreds of tribes annexed each other, and gradually turned into large tribes with tens of thousands of people, so that they could survive.

So let these ignorant barbarians understand the existence of such things as cities. The legendary city is made of countless mud and boulders, which are constantly piled up, reaching a height of several meters and tens of meters, to defend against the attacks of other tribes.

Living in it is extremely safe and can accommodate a population of several thousand people. The tribe can usually hunt outside during the day, rest inside at night, and hide in the house to keep warm when it is cold in winter.

But wouldn't that require at least a tribe of tens of thousands of people to build it? Usually those small tribes with thousands or hundreds of people simply do not have the financial resources and manpower to establish them. They usually spend their time hunting to maintain their livelihoods, and they can't tell anyone to build the city.

Only those large tribes with tens of thousands of people can have hundreds of new ones, day by day, slowly build the foundation of the city wall, and slowly build a big city over a few years, The big tribes in the alliance did the same.

Those warriors in the tribe who used to fight with the alliance army, when the alliance leader assembled the army and renovated the combat readiness. I was fortunate enough to go to the leader of the tribal alliance to see those big cities with my own eyes. The big city belonging to the leader has a wall of fifteen meters high.

All of them are constructed of boulders and are indestructible. The sharp iron tools carefully crafted by master craftsmen in ordinary tribes can only be separated by a shallow layer of skin. It also accommodates a population of thousands of people, and countless people thrive in it. The total number of people in the entire city is comparable to dozens of tribes like myself.

Not to mention, the powerhouses in the city are like clouds, possessing extraordinary powers to control Dou Qi, and the number of Wu Li is countless. These are all alliance leaders, who usually gather hundreds of thousands of people in the entire alliance. After decades of accumulation, they were slowly formed.

Russia, who is riding a strange monster in front of him, is actually the army of Luoyang City. Could it be that there is a city in the surrounding tribes? This powerful force has at least tens of thousands of people, thousands of troops, and dozens of people above the second rank, but why didn't I receive any news before?

It stands to reason that the rise of this kind of tribe will definitely shock the entire alliance. It must be that person who is deceiving himself. If there is such a tribe, he will definitely receive the news. How could it be possible, I hadn't heard anything about it for so long before.

Even if the information within the alliance is blocked and there is not much communication, but every tens of thousands of tribes are promoted, the leader of the alliance will send his messenger to inform every member of the alliance, let them know that there is such a existence, avoid because of ignorance. He collided with him, and suffered a disaster.

However, look at those people riding unified monsters, wearing fine armor and holding sharp weapons. These are not something that a small tribe of thousands of people can equip, and it cannot be built without tens of thousands, or even tens of thousands.

The tribal leader was very entangled in his heart, not knowing whether to open the door and accept the surrender, or to resist to the end and see if he could repel them and win the chance for the tribe to continue to survive.

However, he was in the mood to be entangled there, and Zhong Yu was not in the mood to wait for him to figure it out before asking him.

Seeing that he didn't reply to his own words, but was silently dazed there, there was a hint of anger in his heart. Since he became the lord of thousands of people, no one has dared to ignore his words so much.

He couldn't help but make up his mind that even if he really surrendered, he would have to concoct him well, so that he could understand what it means to not commit Tianwei. Immediately ordered, the cavalry attacked, and let them understand what kind of enemy they were facing.

Da-da-da, the sound of horses' hooves sounded, followed by a rain of arrows, which fell into the tribe like raindrops. These guards are equipped with delicate hand crossbows that can fire ten crossbows in a row, with a firing rate of one shot every three seconds.

After the seven rounds of arrow rain, seven hundred arrow feathers were injected into the tribe, and a wailing sound suddenly sounded. The casualties were heavy, and there were corpses everywhere. The tribe that originally had more than 150 combat strength was suddenly left, and only fifty people were able to stand up. It is difficult for them who have never seen such a thing as a crossbow to appreciate the power of such a small but undeniable weapon.

Before hitting the horse again, Zhong Yu once again read out his conditions. The tribal leader who was lucky enough to survive just now, looking at the current situation of his tribe, couldn't help but feel grief and anger in his heart, and he almost wanted to run out of the knight desperately.

But at this time the current situation of the tribe, could not help but tell him again and again, now the tribe can no longer bear the great loss. If you fight again, maybe all your own people will die, and you won't be able to cause them any harm.

In desperation, the leader could only give up his anger and extinguish his hatred. With the remaining members of his tribe, he came out and surrendered with fear in his heart.

Zhong Yu fulfilled his oath and turned the leader of this tribe and the rest into his own servant army. He planned to use the remnants of the army that had just surrendered as cannon fodder in the remaining two tribes. . And I will supervise them from the rear, but they dare not step back, to punish the leader for ignoring the consequences of his words.

The latter two tribes did not have the slightest accident, and were easily pacified by Zhong Yu. Except for the cannon fodder of the fifty or so people who were all killed and wounded, and no one survived, most of them died under the arrows of their knights without any twists and turns.

Zhong Yu will never tolerate those who escape from the battle, especially those people who have offended themselves, so they don't take the opportunity to fall into trouble and give them small shoes. Where is Zhong Yu's character!

The novice is on the road for support, and the results of this book are too poor. All the data are worse than those of the same period.
